faq_heading: Homes near Georges Vanier Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Georges Vanier Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Georges Vanier Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Georges Vanier Elementary. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Georges Vanier Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 88 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,143,750, townhomes $666,500, condos $491,500. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Georges Vanier Elementary?
faq.a: For the 88 homes that sold within 1 km of Georges Vanier Elementary, the median time on the market was 38 days and the median sale was 97.0% of list; 12% sold above list.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Georges Vanier Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are M B Sanford Elementary (0.7 km north), Hyland Elementary (0.8 km south-west) and T E Scott Elementary (1.2 km east).

Georges Vanier Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 6985 142 St. It teaches grades K to 7.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Georges Vanier Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the Georges Vanier Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Georges Vanier Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Georges Vanier Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 88 homes sold within 1 km of Georges Vanier Elementary: 32 houses, 36 townhomes and 18 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $666,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Georges Vanier Elementary

28 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Georges Vanier Elementary in a straight line (19 elementary, 6 secondary, 3 other; 5 independent). The closest is M B Sanford Elementary, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Newton Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Frank Hurt Secondary (1.5 km); the nearest independent school is Surrey Muslim School (1.8 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary (2.2 km). Other elementary schools close by: M B Sanford Elementary (0.7 km north), Hyland Elementary (0.8 km south-west), T E Scott Elementary (1.2 km east), McLeod Road Traditional (1.3 km south), Chimney Hill Elementary (1.4 km north-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is M B Sanford Elementary, 0.7 km north of Georges Vanier Elementary.
